verdict.rationale: Perplexity documents a built-in Assistant that drafts emails, schedules appointments and books reservations, plus a Computer agent that takes multi-step tasks, browsing, code execution and 400+ service connectors. One hands-on community report says Computer often fails to trigger from the UI and sessions stall. That caveat applies to one surface only and doesn't contradict the Assistant. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on the in-app Assistant's task scope and limits, independent corroboration that delegated tasks complete reliably in the consumer UI

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Assistant: Draft emails, schedule appointments, book reservations, and more.
your MCP client can delegate complex, multi-step work to Computer and receive structured results.
When a task requires interacting with a website, filling forms, or accessing login-gated content, Computer launches a browser session automatically.
**Connect to 400+ services** through a managed connector framework with one-click OAuth
